title: Reviewers and advisors: who checks the work, and how to weigh them
summary: Drake never lets an agent be the only check on its own change. Read-only reviewer agents and a security reviewer read finished lanes, and a small roster of advisor seats each hold one office: intent, a witness that finds the artifact behind every claim, numbers recomputed in Wolfram, direction, and trust. To weigh reviews: act where they agree with evidence, run the cheapest separating check where they disagree, verify a lone finding yourself, drop unsupported claims.
goal: Separate the author from the checker and turn several reviews into a decision based on evidence.
key_steps: Use a read-only reviewer that did not write the change
Give each advisor seat one narrow office and require concrete evidence
Act when reviewers agree with evidence
When they disagree, run the cheapest check that separates them
Open the cited artifact yourself for a lone finding
Drop findings that carry no evidence

example.code:
note weigh: turn two reviewers' verdicts on each finding into ACT, CHECK, VERIFY or DROP
note exit 0 every line weighed, 2 read error, 3 malformed line (fail closed)
text KW "ACT (both reviewers agree, with evidence)\nCHECK (they disagree: run the cheapest check that separates them)\nVERIFY (one evidenced finding: open the cited artifact yourself)\nDROP (no evidenced finding)\nREFUSE malformed line \n\n: \nact=\n check=\n verify=\n drop=\n"
note helpers: read all of stdin into inb, walk lines, compare a line prefix with the n-th
note entry of the newline separated table KW, and write table entries, input bytes and numbers
global inb uchar 65536
global num uchar 24
fn rdall to long
t = ulong 0
while lt t len inb bound 65536
k = read 0 inb t sub len inb t
if lt k 0
ret k
end
if eq k 0
ret long t
end
t = add t ulong k
end
ret neg long 27
end
fn eol s ulong n ulong to ulong
i = s
while lt i n bound 65536
if eq get inb i 10
ret i
end
i = add i 1
end
ret n
end
fn kstart k ulong to ulong
p = ulong 0
c = ulong 0
while lt c k bound 4096
if eq get KW p 10
c = add c 1
end
p = add p 1
end
ret p
end
fn klen k ulong to ulong
s = kstart k
i = s
while ne get KW i 10 bound 4096
i = add i 1
end
ret sub i s
end
fn pmat at ulong e ulong k ulong to bool
o = kstart k
m = klen k
if gt m sub e at
ret false
end
for j ulong m
if ne get inb add at j get KW add o j
ret false
end
end
ret true
end
fn emitk o ulong n ulong to void
d = ulong 0
while lt d n bound 4096
w = write 1 KW add o d sub n d
if le w 0
trap 9
end
d = add d ulong w
end
end
fn emiti o ulong n ulong to void
d = ulong 0
while lt d n bound 65536
w = write 1 inb add o d sub n d
if le w 0
trap 9
end
d = add d ulong w
end
end
fn emitn o ulong n ulong to void
d = ulong 0
while lt d n bound 24
w = write 1 num add o d sub n d
if le w 0
trap 9
end
d = add d ulong w
end
end
fn say k ulong to void
emitk kstart k add klen k 1
end
fn word k ulong to void
emitk kstart k klen k
end
fn emitu v ulong to void
p = ulong 24
x = v
while true bound 21
p = sub p 1
put num p uchar add rem x 10 48
x = div x 10
if eq x 0
break
end
end
emitn p sub 24 p
end
note a line is two reviewer verdicts then a label: AB label
note Y finding stands with evidence, N not a defect with evidence, U claim without evidence (no vote)
fn vote c uchar to ulong
if eq c 89
ret 1
end
if eq c 78
ret 2
end
if eq c 85
ret 0
end
ret 9
end
fn shape s ulong e ulong to bool
if lt sub e s 4
ret false
end
if eq vote get inb s 9
ret false
end
if eq vote get inb add s 1 9
ret false
end
ret eq get inb add s 2 32
end
fn count s ulong v ulong to ulong
c = ulong 0
if eq vote get inb s v
c = add c 1
end
if eq vote get inb add s 1 v
c = add c 1
end
ret c
end
fn judge s ulong to ulong
y = count s 1
n = count s 2
if eq y 2
ret 0
end
if eq y 1
if eq n 1
ret 1
end
ret 2
end
ret 3
end
fn main to int
r = rdall
if lt r 0
ret 2
end
n = ulong r
s = ulong 0
ln = ulong 0
tally = new ulong 4 0
while lt s n bound 65536
e = eol s n
ln = add ln 1
if not shape s e
word 4
emitu ln
say 5
ret 3
end
d = judge s
put tally d add get tally d 1
emiti add s 3 sub e add s 3
word 6
say d
s = add e 1
end
for k ulong 4
word add k 7
emitu get tally k
end
say 5
ret 0
end

common_mistake: Obeying the most confident review, or asking the author to double-check itself and calling it a review. Fix: a separate read-only reviewer, and a separating check instead of more opinions when reviewers disagree.
evidence_note: The example ran on a Linux AArch64 host (no GPU) and its output is recorded byte for byte with a negative control. Rests on the recorded run of weigh.om over six findings plus a malformed-verdict control. The advisor roster is described in general terms from Drake's setup. NOT done: no measurement of reviewer accuracy or of how often seats catch real defects.
